name: Tracker Record 8
definition: Specifies the agent specific tracking system information of a payment transaction.

PartyOrAgentIdentification.name: Party Or Agent Identification
PartyOrAgentIdentification.definition: Identification of a party or agent in the tracker.

InterbankSettlementAmount.name: Interbank Settlement Amount
InterbankSettlementAmount.definition: Amount of money moved between the instructing agent and the instructed agent.

ChargeBearer.name: Charge Bearer
ChargeBearer.definition: Specifies which party/parties will bear the charges associated with the processing of the payment transaction.

ChargesAmount.name: Charges Amount
ChargesAmount.definition: Transaction charges to be paid by the charge bearer.

ExchangeRateData.name: Exchange Rate Data
ExchangeRateData.definition: Provides details of the rate and the currencies used in the foreign exchange.

ProcessingDateTime.name: Processing Date Time
ProcessingDateTime.definition: Date/time at which the instruction was processed by the specified party.
